title: Howdy Blend Request: A Day Among the Vineyards With Our Tech Community in Santiago
summary: Our tech community in Chile blended their own wine and shared a five-course dinner among the vineyards. Here's how Howdy Blend Request went.
body_markdown:
On November 14th, we traded the IDE for a wine glass. We spent the day at Viña Casas del Bosque, away from the city, with developers and tech professionals in Chile.


That day was **Howdy Blend Request** , an invite-only experience we put together for our community. If you've ever opened a pull request, you already get half the joke.


## **Winemaker for a day**


The day started with "Enólogo por un día" (winemaker for a day), where every guest blended their own wine. Nobody showed any signs of oenophobia (yes, the fear of wine has a name).


Then we sat down at Casa Mirador for a five-course paired dinner, with the vineyards all around us.


> [View this post on Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/p/DfvykcZxKMm/)


## **Why a vineyard**


In April, we met the Chilean tech community at[Nerdearla Chile](https://www.howdylatam.com/blog/howdy-nerdearla-chile-sponsor-latam-tech-event) , between talks. This time we wanted a longer table and the slower kind of conversation.


Between the tasting and the courses, people from the community met each other, swapped career stories and got to know the Howdy team, with no schedule rushing anyone along. That's what Blend Request was for: to keep growing our community in Chile and across Latin America.


## **What our guests told us**


Every guest who answered our survey rated the experience 5/5, and all of them said this kind of event helps people outside Howdy get to know us better.


> "Making our own wine."


> "The organizers took care of every detail and made sure my dietary restriction was handled perfectly."


Others talked about the table and the view ("The food was great and the landscapes were incredible.") and about the group: "The Howdy staff was always attentive, and the group was really lively."


## **One last toast**


At Howdy, we connect developers in Latin America with companies in the US. In Chile, that community now has a vineyard on its map.


Thanks to everyone who raised a glass with us. Salud!
